document.title: TextInput with Vita IME dialog and host keyboard editing
document.summary: Adds a controlled `TextInput` to `@vitadeck/sdk`, backed by a new `vita-text-input` native instance. A Press starts an edit: the Vita opens `sceImeDialog`, the desktop host edits in place, and `onChange` fires once on confirm.
document.why: Deck Apps need a way to [enter text](source:s1), and the approval requires the desktop host to be a [first-class path](source:s2), not a fallback.

sources.title: Text input
sources.gist: Approved design proposal: controlled TextInput, IME dialog on Vita, in-place host editing, onChange once on confirm, no onSubmit.

sources.label: #48 approval
sources.gist: Máté approved with one requirement: it must also work on the desktop host as a first-class path.

lookFor: The [proposal](source:s1) expected a raylib-vita swap change for the common dialog; none is needed because raylib-vita's `SwapScreenBuffer` calls `SDL_GL_SwapWindow`, which calls `vglSwapBuffers(GL_TRUE)` every frame.

The [proposal](source:s1) put the F1-cancels-editing rule in `src/ui/input.c`; it lives in `src/main.c`, which cancels any edit whenever the Deck App does not own input (Shell open, runtime not ready or failed).
`TextInput` also takes `borderRadius`, which the [proposal](source:s1) did not list, to match `Button` geometry.
`maxLength` counts UTF-16 code units like `string.length` on both platforms; the [proposal](source:s1) did not say what it counts.
Untested on hardware: the Vita path compiles in the Vitasdk Docker build only, and a TextInput with no `placeholder` passes an empty dialog title.

groups.title: Platform text input: IME dialog and host keyboard
groups.why: The Vita IME and raylib keyboard code stays behind `src/platform/`, as AGENTS.md asks for platform quirks; the [proposal](source:s1) names this split.
groups.summary: `text_input.h` defines one begin/poll/cancel session that `text_input_vita.c` implements with `sceImeDialog` and `text_input_host.c` with raylib keys, and CMake picks one per target.
lookFor: Subtle: the host toggles `SetExitKey(KEY_NULL)` while editing, so Escape cancels the edit instead of quitting; outside an edit Escape still closes the window as before.
Subtle: Vita cancel calls `sceImeDialogAbort` and the dialog terminates on a later `vd_text_input_poll`; a `begin` before that returns false, so a Press during the abort starts no edit.
`vd_text_input_apply_keys` is declared for both targets but only defined on the host; nothing on the Vita calls it.

groups.title: String payload on the input event queue
groups.why: `InputEvent` only holds 32-byte names, so a confirmed value needs its own payload, as the [proposal](source:s1) says.
groups.summary: `InputEvent` gains an owned `text` pointer for `EVT_TEXT_INPUT`, which the queue frees when full or cleared and `process_input_events` frees after calling `onTextInputFromNative`.
lookFor: Every popper now owns `evt.text`; `process_input_events` and the input harness `drain` free it, and a new popper that skips `free` leaks under LSan.

groups.title: vita-text-input instance and rendering
groups.why: The reconciler needs a native instance to create, hit-test, focus and paint.
groups.summary: `NT_TEXT_INPUT` props built by `nativeCreateTextInput`/`nativeUpdateTextInput` flow through the snapshot into hit testing, focus collection, Scroll flow layout and `render_text_input_instance`.
lookFor: `instance_is_button` is renamed `instance_is_focusable` and also accepts `NT_TEXT_INPUT`, so mouse hover and press now focus a TextInput like a Button.

The renderer trims overflowing text with `fit_text` instead of a scissor, because a nested `BeginScissorMode` would end a parent Scroll's clip; while editing it keeps the end visible so the caret stays inside.

groups.title: Editing session in the input loop
groups.why: A Press must start an edit and the confirmed value must reach the runtime, while other Deck App input waits.
groups.summary: `push_press` starts an edit through `vd_text_input_begin`, `main.c` polls the session every frame and skips the other polls while it runs, and `input_apply_text_input` pushes `EVT_TEXT_INPUT` on confirm.
lookFor: Subtle: `end_text_input` marks Cross, touch and the mouse button as already down, so the Enter or Cross that confirmed does not press the TextInput again on release; the harness checks this with a held `confirm`.
While an edit runs, mouse clicks elsewhere do nothing on the host; the edit is modal on both platforms.
Removing the edited instance cancels the edit on the next poll and reports no value.

groups.title: SDK TextInput and runtime wiring
groups.why: Authors get the component from the [proposal](source:s1); the runtime maps it to the native calls.
groups.summary: `TextInput` renders `vita-text-input`, whose props the reconciler passes to `nativeCreateTextInput`/`nativeUpdateTextInput` and whose `onChange` handler `onTextInputFromNative` calls.
lookFor: `autoFocus` now also schedules `commitMount` for `vita-text-input`; defaults are `RAYWHITE` fill, `BLACK` text, font size 20 and `maxLength` 256.

groups.title: Chat compose row
groups.why: An example Deck App exercises the component without touching the Genesys files.
groups.summary: The chat compose row adds a `TextInput` whose trimmed draft `sendMessage` sends instead of the scripted suggestion, then clears.

groups.title: Glossary, host mappings and SDK README
groups.why: AGENTS.md asks to keep CONTEXT.md, the Host mappings table and the SDK README accurate when input changes.
groups.summary: CONTEXT.md adds **Text Input**, its relationships and three host mapping rows, and the SDK README adds a Text input section; wording only.
